name: VO2 Max 5x3min Intervals
description:

- 12m 55-65% 90rpm
- 3x 30s 115% / 30s 55%
- 3m 55%

Main Set 5x
- 3m 112-118% 100rpm Max sustainable aerobic power
- 3m 50% 85rpm Recovery

Cooldown

name: Gym - Lower Body Power & Core
description:
Focus: Power & neuromuscular recruitment on same day as VO2max to consolidate hard stress.

Warmup:
- 5m hip mobility & dynamic stretching

Main Lifts:
- Trap Bar Deadlift: 4x5 @ RPE 7.5
- Romanian Deadlift (RDL): 3x8 @ RPE 7
- Bulgarian Split Squat: 3x8/side
- Standing Calf Raises: 3x12

Core:
- Ab Wheel Rollouts: 3x10
- Side Planks: 3x45s

name: Active Recovery Spin
description:
Easy Spin
- 40m 45-55% 90-95rpm Keep HR Zone 1 strictly

name: Gym - Upper Body & Posture
description:
Focus: Postural endurance for drop bars & aero position.

Main Lifts:
- Standing Overhead Press: 4x6-8
- Chest-Supported DB Row: 4x8-10
- Incline DB Bench Press: 3x8-10
- Face Pulls: 3x15

Core Anti-Rotation:
- Pallof Press: 3x12/side
- Planks: 3x60s
